calibration.n_prior_default.desc: Shrinkage anchor. n=N_PRIOR hits 50/50 data/prior weight. Lower = trust data faster (more aggressive learning, more variance).

calibration.n_prior_per_market.desc: Per-market shrinkage override. Rare/noisy markets (HR, RBI) need higher; high-volume (hits/TB) lower.

calibration.max_correction.desc: Maximum multiplicative correction (cap on bias adjustment per refresh). 1.35 = ±35% band.

calibration.min_sample_for_any_correctio.desc: Below this many settled outcomes, correction is forced to 1.0 (no change).

player_bias.min_player_n.desc: Minimum settled records on a player+market before a per-player override fires.

player_bias.z_threshold.desc: Standard-deviations from market mean residual to flag a player as systematically off.

player_bias.max_boost.desc: Cap on per-player multiplier (less aggressive than market-level because n is smaller).

live_edges.edge_threshold_pp.desc: Percentage-points divergence between model_p_win and book implied to trigger a live alert.

plays.min_edge_pct.desc: Minimum model-vs-book edge to surface a play (else SKIP). Higher = more selective.

plays.max_kelly_units.desc: Hard cap on recommended stake per play in units, regardless of model confidence.

plays.pre_cal_edge_cap_pct.desc: Edge above this is treated as pre-calibration noise -- Kelly forced to <=0.5u + display capped.

parlays.max_leg_prob.desc: Cap on per-leg probability used in parlay EV math. Prevents thin-sample 99% probs from compounding to absurd EVs.

parlays.suppress_edge_below_pct.desc: Single-leg edges below this don't qualify as parlay legs.

parlays.suppress_edge_above_pct.desc: Single-leg edges above this are likely pre-cal noise; rejected as parlay legs.

parlays.max_ev_pct.desc: Maximum parlay EV to surface (over this is almost certainly noise).

trainer.min_train_sample.desc: Per-market settled-outcome threshold before a market graduates to TRAINABLE.

trainer.blend_grid.desc: Statcast-vs-season blend weights tried by the grid search.

trainer.amplifier_grid.desc: Multiplier amplifiers tried by multiplier_tuner on opp_mult / umpire_k_mult / park_hand_mult.

props.max_games.desc: Cap on # of games to fetch props for, to fit Odds API quota.

backfill.max_players_gamelog.desc: Cap on player gamelog pulls per cron run (MLB Stats API rate-limit guard).

backfill.gamelog_depth_games.desc: How many games back to pull per-player gamelog for sparkline.

walk_forward.window_days.desc: Rolling window size for walk-forward Brier evaluation.

walk_forward.min_window_samples.desc: Skip windows with fewer than this many records.

anomalies.systematic_z_threshold.desc: Z-score threshold to flag a player+market pair as a systematic anomaly.

anomalies.outlier_z_threshold.desc: Z-score threshold for a single-day outlier (freak game).

rationales.max_props_props_path.desc: Max rationales to generate from props.json per cron run (HTTP-bound).

rationales.max_props_pickem_path.desc: Max rationales to generate from pickem.json per cron run.
